title: Division by Zero on Empty Numbers List
description: average([]) raises ZeroDivisionError when an empty list is passed
known_issue: No empty list check before division sum(numbers) / len(numbers)
expected_behavior: Raise ValueError('Cannot calculate average of an empty list') when numbers is empty
regression_test:
import pytest
from app.calculator import average

def test_case_01():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        average([])

title: Discount Percentage Boundary Validation
description: calculate_discount accepts discount > 100% and negative discounts, causing negative prices
known_issue: Missing validation for discount_percent range [0.0, 100.0] and price >= 0
expected_behavior: Raise ValueError when discount_percent < 0 or > 100 or price < 0
regression_test:
import pytest
from app.calculator import calculate_discount

def test_case_02():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        calculate_discount(100.0, 120.0)

title: Off-by-One Loop Starting Index Skips First Element
description: find_first_positive fails to inspect the element at index 0 because loop starts at range(1, len(numbers))
known_issue: Loop index starts at 1 instead of 0
expected_behavior: Inspect all elements starting at index 0

title: Unhandled Empty String in User Age Parsing
description: parse_user_age crashes without validation when an empty or whitespace string is provided
known_issue: Direct int(age_str) call without validating empty or whitespace input
expected_behavior: Raise ValueError for empty or non-numeric string input
regression_test:
import pytest
from app.calculator import parse_user_age

def test_case_04():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_user_age('  ')

title: Null or Empty User Identifier in Summary Generation
description: format_user_summary fails when user_id is None or blank string
known_issue: Missing validation for None or empty user_id string
expected_behavior: Raise ValueError('user_id is required') when user_id is None or empty
regression_test:
import pytest
from app.calculator import format_user_summary

def test_case_05():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='user_id is required'):
        format_user_summary(None)

title: Direct Dict Key Access Triggers KeyError
description: get_user_role accesses dictionary key without checking if username exists
known_issue: Direct access users_dict[username]['role'] raises KeyError without friendly message
expected_behavior: Raise KeyError with friendly message or return default
regression_test:
import pytest
from app.data_store import get_user_role

def test_case_06():
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        get_user_role({}, 'unknown_user')

title: Mutable Default Argument Causes State Leak Across Invocations
description: append_to_cache uses cache=[] default parameter which accumulates across calls
known_issue: Mutable default argument in Python function definition
expected_behavior: Use None as default and initialize empty list inside function body
regression_test:
from app.data_store import append_to_cache

def test_case_07():
    r1 = append_to_cache('a')
    r2 = append_to_cache('b')
    assert r2 == ['b']

title: Boundary Condition in Binary Search Causes IndexError
description: binary_search initializes high = len(arr) and uses while low <= high
known_issue: high should be len(arr) - 1 to prevent IndexError when target > all elements
expected_behavior: Returns -1 without out-of-bounds error when target is greater than all elements

title: AttributeError on Missing Configuration Section
description: read_config_value calls .get(key) on None when config section is missing
known_issue: Calling .get(key) on None raises AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'get'
expected_behavior: Return None safely if section does not exist
